summary: Costamare Inc., a Monaco-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 6, 2026, reporting the election of one Class I director, Konstantinos Zacharatos, at the company's virtual 2026 annual meeting, to serve until the 2029 annual meeting. Stockholders also ratified Ernst & Young (Hellas) as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. No terms, board recommendation on a transaction, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine annual-meeting results notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
